note: Glenmark reports one operating segment (pharmaceuticals) and revenue by region in every quarterly release: India, North America, Europe, Emerging Markets (company calls it Rest of the World until FY25: Russia/CIS, LATAM, MEA, APAC) and other revenue. Rs crore. Until FY23 an API line (Glenmark Life Sciences) was reported; FY23 was restated without it after the Mar-2024 sale (continuing operations). North America in FY26 and Q2FY26-Q1FY27 includes ISB 2001 out-licensing income (Q2FY26 Rs3,670 cr net of Rs830 cr one-time charges; then US$17.5mn a quarter of deferred upfront); naCore strips it out using the company's stated core growth rates. FY26 Europe Rs3,100.7 cr is the company's segment table (AR financial-capital section); note 19's geographic split shows Rs3,179.4 cr (other revenue allocated). Q1FY25 is back-calculated from the Q1FY26 growth rates (no prior-year column found); FY25 quarters otherwise from the prior-year columns of the FY26 releases and calls. EBITDA = company basis (Screener's operating profit; FY26 includes the licensing income).
